title: API memory limit too low
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API container, the memory‑limit issue, and the trigger of lowering the limit.
root_cause: The API container's memory limit was reduced from 512 MiB to 150 MiB 30 minutes ago, causing the kernel's cgroup OOM killer to terminate the process (exit code 137) each time the app exceeds the new limit.
truth: Someone lowered the api container's memory limit from 512MiB to 150MiB, below its normal working set of ~180MiB, so the kernel OOM killer repeatedly terminates it (exit code 137).
check_first: docker logs of the api container
